# hallpass_operator (Data Source)

Looks up an operator by email (for example for `hallpass_approver_rule`). Operators are invited and managed in the console, not by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hallpass_operator" "ada" {
  email = "ada@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the operator is enabled.
- `groups` (Set of String) Operator groups.
- `id` (String) Operator ID.
- `roles` (Set of String) Operator roles.
